# driftwood

> driftwood (driftwood.sh) is an AI SDR — an AI sales agent for cold outbound. It researches each prospect, builds them a custom product demo, and sends the message from the founder's own account. Every message is human reviewed before it sends.

## What driftwood does

- Researches each prospect: reads everything public about them and their company.
- Builds them a custom demo: a live, personalized artifact that shows what your product does for their specific business — not a template with a first-name merge tag.
- Sends it from your account (LinkedIn or email), only after a human approves it in a review queue. Nothing sends without sign-off.

## Why it works

Generic AI-written outreach ("AI slop") gets ignored. A message that opens with something real — like a bug the agent actually found on the prospect's own site, with a short demo video of it — earns replies. In week one at Autosana (YC S25), replies on the same lead list went from under 1% to over 14%, including founders who had ignored more than four months of prior outreach; one replied within about 12 hours to book a call.

## Who it's for

B2B founders and teams who do cold outbound (email or LinkedIn) and want every message to carry a personalized, working demo instead of generic copy. Relevant if you're evaluating AI SDR tools, AI sales agents, or sales outreach automation and don't want templated sequences.
